title: The Whole village of the valley
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：whole　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 whole 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the driver wrote of ① a whole village of the valley in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② so whole that nobody in the station would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the whole ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the whole village of the valley that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1949 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too whole to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the whole ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a whole story of the family, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as whole as the story of the family they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was whole or not, and he said so.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something whole, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite whole; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the whole ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965, before dawn, she wrote of another whole village of the valley in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less whole than anybody had expected. ⑩ The whole story of the family that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1967, was the one she could never quite name; the whole ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 整个（前置定语 a whole village of the valley：1955 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件整个的山谷里整个村子）
B. adj. 整个／完整（两处加强说法：so whole that … 与 no less whole than …）
C. adj. 整个／完整（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 整个（表语 too whole to do：母亲觉得它太整个，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 完整（前置定语 a whole story of the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩完整的全部往事）
F. adj. 完整（同级比较 as whole as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩这家人的全部往事相比）
G. adj. 完整（后置定语 something whole：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 完整（受程度副词修饰 quite whole：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a whole village of the valley
the whole village of the valley that
a whole story of the family
The whole story of the family that

answers.why: whole 意为“整个”，1955 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件整个的山谷里整个村子”，此处作前置定语 a whole village of the valley。
whole 意为“整个”，此处用 so whole that 结构，说它整个到车站里没人敢靠近。
whole 意为“整个”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的整个山谷里整个村子，等于最高级的说法。
whole 意为“整个”，母亲认为这件东西“太整个了，谁也用不上”，too whole to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
whole 意为“完整”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩完整的全部往事”，此处作前置定语 a whole story of the family。
whole 意为“完整”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩这家人的全部往事一样完整”，同级比较用 as whole as。
whole 意为“完整”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“完整的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something whole。
whole 意为“完整”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当完整”，quite 修饰原级 whole。
whole 意为“完整”，no less whole than 表示“其完整不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之完整不亚于任何人的预料。
whole 意为“完整”，母亲 1967 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的完整全部往事”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件整个的山谷里整个村子。（a whole village of the valley）
它整个到车站里没有一个人敢靠近。（so whole that …）
母亲觉得它太整个，谁也用不上。（too whole to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩完整的全部往事。（a whole story of the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩这家人的全部往事一样完整。（as whole as …）
到了 1962 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件完整的东西。（something whole）
answers: In 1955 the driver wrote of a whole village of the valley in the timetable.
It was so whole that nobody in the station would go near it.
My mother thought it too whole to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a whole story of the family.
He said nobody would call it as whole as the story of the family they had once had.
By 1962 the timetable asked for nothing but something whole.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 whole 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the driver wrote of a whole village of the valley in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the whole village of the valley that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too whole to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a whole story of the family, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite whole, and everybody laughed.
The whole ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
